note: The default legend moves the chart area, so the y pixels of the points differ between the modes all and none (changedBy legend). The assertion reads only toContain of the first element, and the hit set is the same in both modes. Thus no plugin changes the asserted result. The skeptic run confirms it: the hit set has the same elements (the same x pixels) in the modes all and none; only the y pixels differ by less than 0.2 px.
